generatedFor.loaderHint: C++ generator: UProceduralMeshComponent or GeometryScript DynamicMesh per plate, attached to SKM_Manny sockets; deploy path Content/Story/armor_kit.json

coordinateSystem.rotation: FRotator degrees (pitch about Y, yaw about Z, roll about X), applied Roll->Pitch->Yaw as UE does

frames.component: Origin at the bone's ref-pose position; axes = character component space (X fwd, Y right, Z up). Used for head, neck, spine, pelvis, clavicle, foot, ball.
frames.limb: Origin at the bone. Z_seg = unit(bonePos - limbChildPos) (points back UP the limb, so plate z is negative toward the child), X_seg = component +X made orthogonal to Z_seg (Gram-Schmidt), Y_seg = Z_seg x X_seg. For a hanging left arm / standing left leg this equals component axes, i.e. the SuitRig pivot frame. Used for upperarm, lowerarm, hand, fingers, thigh, calf (and their twist bones via frameBone).
frames.frameBone: If present, the plate is authored in frameBone's frame but attached (socketed) to 'bone'. RelativeTransform = PlateCS * Inverse(RefPoseCS(bone)).

coordinateSystem.plateLocalAxes: extrudeShell: profile in (u,v) where u = +Y, v = +Z of the plate frame; extrusion/thickness goes inward along -X (outer surface faces +X). wrapU/wrapV = radius of cylindrical wrap about the plate's local Z / Y axis, centre at -wrap along X (null = flat). loftShell: stations along plate Z, theta measured from +X toward +Y (theta 0 = front, -90 = left/lateral for left limbs, +90 = medial).

mannyBoneLocalAxes.note: For reference only; this kit never uses raw bone-local axes. Typical UE5 Manny: limb bones' local +X points to the child on the LEFT side and -X on the RIGHT (mirrored); spine bones +X points up the spine. Verify in the Skeleton editor before relying on it.
mannyBoneLocalAxes.reason: Segment frames avoid dependence on per-bone roll differences between Manny, Quinn and retargeted skeletons.

geometryTypes.extrudeShell: profile [[u,v]] (+holes, circleCuts, polyCuts, cornerRadius, studs), optionally wrapped on cylinders wrapU/wrapV, extruded inward by thickness, bevelled on outer edges
geometryTypes.loftShell: stations [{z,rx,ry,n}] superellipse sections |x/rx|^n+|y/ry|^n=1, arc {start,end} deg; shell thickness inward
geometryTypes.revolve: profile [[r,h]] revolved about 'axis' (default X); thickness 0 = solid
geometryTypes.superellipsoidShell: center, radii [x,y,z], exponents [e1,e2], clip planes {n,d} (keep n.p <= d)

panelLineTypes.seam: loft longitudinal groove at theta between z[0..1]
panelLineTypes.ringX: cylinder/sell rings at local x positions

panelLineRules.profile: V-groove with 0.03 cm flat bottom; cut into the outer shell surface only
panelLineRules.belowMin: skip geometry, leave for normal map

layering.rule: Explicit 'overlaps' are authoritative. 'layer' is a coarse sort key within a segment (higher = further out); the generator pushes an 'over' plate outward by layerGap where its footprint covers the other plate.

overlapModes.over: this plate's edge sits on top of the named plate by cm along 'edge'
overlapModes.under: this plate tucks under the named plate
overlapModes.onTop: bolted on the face of the named plate (no edge overlap)
overlapModes.cut: this plate's footprint is boolean-subtracted from the named plate with cm clearance

shoulder.strategy: Pauldron on clavicle (no arm swing); deltoid caps on upperarm_twist_01 overlap pauldron underside 2.5 cm; at >70 deg abduction pauldron slides up (see slidingPlates).

elbow.strategy: Elbow cap on lowerarm_l; upper-arm lower shell overlaps cap 1.5 cm; inner side open 5 deg (forearm arc stops at 175) for flexion to 140 deg.

wrist.strategy: Cuff on lowerarm_twist_01 follows pronation; hand back tucks under cuff 0.8 cm.

spine.strategy: Abs rows each on their own spine bone overlapping the row below 0.8 cm, so flexion telescopes the lames instead of intersecting.

hip.strategy: Pelvis hip/rear plates overlap thigh outer/rear 1.5 cm; thigh_twist_01 carries the outer shell; undersuit shows at deep flexion.

knee.strategy: Knee cap on calf_l, thigh front tucks under it 2 cm; shin front under it 1.5 cm.

ankle.strategy: Shin front overlaps boot cuff 2 cm; ankle ring on calf_twist_01; vamp under toe cap 1 cm; sole split at ball_l.

mirror.rule: For every plate with side 'L' and mirror != false: copy, id/name suffix _l->_r and L->R (e.g. ChestPecL->ChestPecR), bones _l->_r (incl. fallbackBone/frameBone/overlap refs), location.y -> -y, vertices/profile u -> -u, reverse triangle winding, yaw -> -yaw, roll -> -roll, loft theta -> -theta (arc start/end swap and negate). side 'C' plates are symmetric and authored once; side 'R' or mirror:false are one-sided.
mirror.nameRule: Mirrored names keep the ClassifyGlow keyword (Eye/Palm/Reactor...).

glow.reactor.alsoOther: Names matching no rule (e.g. 'Jet') classify as Other and follow the reactor colour (eyes if reactor is null).

glow.repulsors.note: intensity driven by firing state at runtime

materialSlots.nullChannelRule: If the bound emissive channel is null in suit_materials, set EmissiveStrength 0 and don't spawn a light (mark-i repulsors, arachnid reactor).

skeleton.verification: Bone names verified against the UE5 Manny/Quinn hierarchy (UE 5.x Mannequin, 89 bones incl. ik_*, interaction, center_of_mass) as listed in Epic's IK Retargeter docs/templates. Loader MUST still check FReferenceSkeleton::FindBoneIndex at runtime and fall back to fallbackBone, then to the rig proxy.

twistBones.note: Driven by ABP_Manny_PostProcess / Control Rig (not by animation). Plates bound to twist_01 follow forearm pronation / upper-arm roll without candy-wrapping.

nominalPoseCm.note: Approximate component-space joint positions for a 180 cm Manny in the ref pose, LEFT side only (mirror Y for _r). Arms shown hanging (A/I-pose is irrelevant: plates are authored in segment frames, see coordinateSystem). Use only for previews or when the skeleton is unavailable; real positions come from RefSkeleton.

scaling.rule: per segment s = refBoneLength / nominalBoneLength, clamp 0.8..1.25; scale along segment Z only, radii scale by sqrt(s)

rigFallback.note: When no SKM_Manny is present, attach to SuitRig scene components: head/neck/spine/pelvis -> Body root with component positions from skeleton.nominalPoseCm; *_l arm bones -> ShoulderL, *_r -> ShoulderR, leg -> HipL/HipR, using limb frames (identical to rig pivot axes for hanging limbs).
rigFallback.pivotMismatch: SuitRig ShoulderL/R at (0,-/+28,150) and HipL/R at (0,-/+13,95) are wider than Manny (upperarm (-1,-/+18,145), thigh (0,-/+9.5,94)). Recommend moving rig pivots to Manny positions or offsetting fallback plates by the difference.
rigFallback.fallbackOnlyTag: fallbackOnly plates (undersuit tubes) are only spawned in rig-fallback mode.

segments.contents: Faceplate (hinged), back shell, jaw/cheek frames, ear discs, nape guard, eyes
Pecs w/ reactor cut, collar, side plates, arc reactor housing + core (or triangle/none variant)
Back plate (upper/lower), stabiliser flaps; backpack variants mount here
Belt ring, codpiece, hip and glute plates
Deltoid caps, clavicle/trapezius plate; pauldron (pads/spiked/cannon) on clavicle
Upper + lower bicep shells, medial strip
Elbow cap, upper/lower forearm shells, wrist cuff
Hand back, knuckle bar, palm plate + repulsor, 15 phalanx shells
Shin front, calf shell, ankle ring
Cuff, instep, heel, toe cap, split sole, boot jet

sleek.notes: Tighter, smoother shell; small ear discs.

angular.notes: Faceted, sharp-edged: Silver Centurion / Shades / XLV / Ultron family.

bulky.notes: +12% everywhere, thick jaw guard; War Machine/Striker/Igor.

none.notes: Arachnid/Ultron: no reactor; null reactor channel glows dark anyway.

mounted.notes: Enum exists in SuitTypes.h (unused by suits.json): proud external housing.

add.name: PauldronL
add.notes: 21 x 19 cm pauldron dome on the clavicle so it does not swing with the arm; roll -15 deg droops it outward; slides up 0-4 cm when the arm abducts (see slidingPlates).

cannon.notes: Right shoulder only (matches SuitRig: cannon +Y). No mirror.

minigun.notes: Left (-Y) only, matching SuitRig minigun placement. No mirror.

add.name: WingL
add.notes: Folded flight wing (stowed along the back, deploys roll +70 deg).

nano.notes: Mk L / LXXXV / Arachnid / Rescue: thin, smooth, flowing nanite shells; only major seams (depthScale >= 0.8).

industrial.notes: Striker/Igor heavy-lift: chamfers, rivets, wide grooves.

heavy.notes: War Machine / Iron Patriot: thick military plate.

crude.notes: Mark I scrap-iron: faceted, thick, weld beads instead of grooves.

partsRules.description: Variant = parts.<field> from suits.json. Apply groups in this order, then style, then suitOverrides.
partsRules.colourBinding: primary/secondary/accent -> suit_materials.suits[id].layers.*; glow.* -> suit_materials emissive.* (null -> dark, no light).

mark-i.why: The only crude-helmet/plating-2 suit and the furthest from the base kit (bucket helmet, bare undersuit arms, no repulsors, flamethrowers): proves the kit spans the whole variant space. Picked over XLII/XLIII whose parts are identical to Mk III and are covered fully by rules.

add.name: MarkICageRing
add.notes: Bare welded cage around the Mk I reactor.

mark-iii.why: The canonical red/gold reference; base kit is authored to it. Override only pins the gold placement so other classic suits inherit a known-good layout.

mark-vii.why: Avengers suit: triangle reactor + missile backpack is the most common non-default combo; adds forearm launcher pods and a heavier neck to show additive bolt-ons.

mark-l.why: Infinity War nanotech: panelLineDepth 0.04 drives the nano style; override adds the hex reactor and back hex so nano suits read differently from Mk III, not just thinner.

mark-lxxxv.why: Endgame suit: nano family but with softer, broader pauldrons and more gold; the second nano pick shows suit-specific tuning on top of a shared style.

war-machine.why: The heaviest silhouette (bulky + cannon + minigun + plating 2) and a non-Stark palette; stresses layering, right-only cannon and left-only minigun.

trademarkCaution: Iron Man, War Machine, Iron Patriot, Rescue and the suit designs/likeness are trademarks and copyrighted designs of Marvel/Disney. CC licences above cover only the creator's copyright in those meshes, not Marvel IP. This kit is an original procedural approximation; for any public/commercial release use original names and colourways, avoid literal film-accurate replicas, and do not use Marvel logos or names in store listings.
implementationNotes: M_CarPaint (build_realism_materials.py) has no PanelNormalStrength parameter although SuitRig ApplyColors sets PanelNormalStrength = panelLineDepth*4; until added, panel lines only show when cut into geometry (this kit cuts them).
IronManArena.Build.cs lacks the ProceduralMeshComponent (or GeometryScriptingCore/GeometryFramework) module; add it before writing the C++ generator.
Glow plates must keep their keyword in the component name (ClassifyGlow).
Cache generated meshes per (suitId, plateId) and share across L/R by mirroring the vertex buffer.
